name: Tokimeki Restaurant ☆☆☆
source:
The story of the game is that you are a girl who just got a job at a cafe which happens to be next to a idol dormitory. In Japan idols are young attractive celebrities that do one or a combination of singing/acting/modeling. In Tokimeki Restaurant (tokires for short) there are two boy musical groups called 3 Majesty and XIP. Both have three members and you meet them all in the intro story. 

This game is another one of those time based restaurant business game but its also a dating simulation game.
translation:
游戏讲述的是一名女孩刚在咖啡馆找到工作，而这家咖啡馆恰好就在偶像宿舍旁边。在日本，偶像是年轻且有魅力的名人，通常从事歌唱、表演、模特等一种或多种工作。《心跳餐厅》（简称Tokires）中有两个男性音乐组合：3 Majesty和X.I.P。两组各有3名成员，你会在序章中与他们全部相遇。

这款游戏既是基于时间推进的餐厅经营游戏，也是恋爱模拟游戏。
